description: Set targets (any of them) and fly some slices. Returns the state afterwards. Targets stay set until changed.

altitude.description: target altitude in m; below 1 m the plane crashes; poles are 33 m tall

circle.description: hold the big circle (true) to hook a pole whose sun says can hook; false lets go of the rope

heading.description: target heading, deg clockwise from north

left.description: turn the heading target this many degrees left of the nose

reel.description: on a taut rope: steer into the pole, away from it, or neither

right.description: turn the heading target this many degrees right of the nose

steps.description: slices of 0.25 s to fly (1 if left out); stops early when something changes on screen

name: pilot_step
